{{Quote|One shot, one kill.|Anonymous clone sniper|<ref name="BF II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
'''Clone sharpshooters''', also known as '''clone snipers''', were a specialized variant of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:Clone_Sniper.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Phase II clone sniper of the 501st Legion during the Raid on the Jedi Temple.]]
Unlike the [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] in any traditional [[Army/Legends|army]], called from the best shooters, all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] possessed the same eyesight, accuracy, steadiness and patience. However, the sharpshooters received special [[flash training]] teaching them the intricacies of being good snipers.<ref name="BF II guide">[[Star Wars Battlefront II: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront II'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> The [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]<ref name="SWE2">{{Film|II}}</ref> who were born on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. They were part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]].<ref name="EGW" /> Their training allowed snipers to wait and shoot enemies one at a time.<ref name="BF I guide">[[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

Their main mission designation was to eliminate [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] infantry from a distance to provide cover fire for other [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] units, while also using their [[Probe droid/Legends|recon droids]] to carry out short-range reconnaissance.<ref name="BF I guide" /> [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I]] clone snipers were recognizable by maroon [[Armor/Legends|armor]] markings. The sharpshooters fought on a number of battlefronts throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="BF I" /> and the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] had their own snipers,<ref name="BF II" /> as did [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]].<ref name="Guantlet">{{StoryCite|story=The Gauntlet of Death|book=Free Comic Book Day 2009 Special|sformatted=''The Gauntlet of Death''|smanual=1}}</ref> After the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Grand Army of the Republic was dissolved and its assets folded into the new [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="EGW" /> Several sharpshooters would be deployed by the Empire during the [[Battle of Dantooine (Imperial Period)|Battle of Dantooine]] to eliminate rebellious civilians led by Jedi Knight [[Falon Grey]] and former Imperial soldier [[X2]].<ref name="BF: ES">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
Clone sharpshooters were equipped with specialized [[DC-15x sniper rifle/Legends|DC-15x sniper rifles]]<ref name="BF I" /> (or for late [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II]] clones, a different unidentified sniper rifle),<ref name="BF II" /> [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15Ss]], [[R-1 recon droid]]s<ref name="BF I guide" /> or [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]],<ref name="BF II" /> and [[V-1 thermal detonator]]s.<ref name="BF I guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clone snipers serve as the Galactic Republic's sniper class in the [[Star Wars Battlefront (series)|''Star Wars: Battlefront'']] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] series.
